name: everos
description: EverOS memory for Codex. Recalls relevant memories before every prompt, saves each finished turn with its full tool-call trajectory, and seals the session on exit. Backed by a local EverOS server, so the same memory is shared with every other agent pointed at it.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-session memory backed by your own EverOS
interface.longDescription: EverOS Memory gives Codex memory that outlives a session and is shared with every other agent pointed at the same EverOS. It recalls what is relevant to the prompt rather than replaying a fixed block, partitions memory per repository, and never leaves your machine unless you point it somewhere else.
